remaining_gates: Root must admit exact completed 13.2 nm x/y/DOS native controls, their lifecycle reconciliation if needed, and their candidate-specific certificate. None is staged here.

Source certificates retain original absolute paths and exact bytes. Portable checking must import stage-local modules, explicitly load staged native paths and write new relocated certificates/report paths without changing originals.
All four original measured CSVs plus MANIFEST_SHA256.json are staged because the native checker validates all four hashes even when 31.8 nm is deferred.
Final mutable index/budget/HANDOFF snapshots are omitted. A later archived budget is execution history, not renewed simulator authorization.
Only postprocessing/verification is authorized by this staging step; do not launch DeckBuild, ATLAS, ATHENA or TonyPlot.

Current scope documents preserve their snapshot language, including then-pending numerical status; final README must use final exact certificate scope and preserve unresolved native-zero/quantum/process limitations.
The archived 182-test result is original-project software evidence. A focused staged test run is separate and needs its planned historical budget fixture before budget tests can run.
Copied runner diagnostic plots/metrics are preserved historical artifacts, not primary full-curve positive-log acceptance; use strict native report denominators and all signed currents.
